episodeTitle.zh: 如何找到热爱的工作 | Bob Moesta（Jobs-to-be-Done框架联合创始人、《Job Moves》作者）

guestBioOfficial.en: Bob Moesta, co-creator of the Jobs to Be Done framework, recently published a new book, Job Moves. Drawing from interviews with over 1,000 people about their career transitions, it offers a practical playbook for career development. In our conversation, we discuss: • The four different “quests” that drive career changes
guestBioOfficial.zh: Bob Moesta，Jobs to Be Done框架的联合创始人，近期出版了新书《Job Moves》。通过对1000多位职业转型者的访谈，该书为职业发展提供了实用指南。在对话中，我们探讨了：• 推动职业变迁的四种不同“探索之旅”

title.en: How to find work you love | Bob Moesta (Jobs-to-be-Done co-creator, author of "Job Moves”)
title.zh: 如何找到热爱的工作 | Bob Moesta（Jobs-to-be-Done框架联合创始人、《Job Moves》作者）

summary.en: Bob introduces his book Job Moves, built on interviewing over a thousand people who switched jobs and finding most ended up worse because they didn't know themselves well enough. He shares the tactic of taking a “jobcation” to reset between roles and distinguishes job features (salary, title) from job experiences that actually keep people engaged. The conversation reframes career transitions as progress moments and offers a practical lens for making better job changes.
summary.zh: Bob 介绍了他的新书《Job Moves》，基于对上千名跳槽者的访谈，发现大多数人因不够了解自己而跳到了更差的工作。他分享了在角色之间“放个职假”（jobcation）来重置状态的技巧，并区分了工作“特征”（薪资、头衔）与真正让人投入的“体验”。对话把职业转换重新框定为“进步时刻”，并提供了做出更好工作选择的实用视角。
